say:3:1621516002:1.text: L-Lady Meowris... I-I am not with them!
say:3:1621516002:1.source_cn: 喵、喵丽丝大人……我、我和他们可不是一伙的……！

say:5:1621516003:1.text: Well, isn't this lively? What is this, a tea party? Funny, I don't see any tea or pastries.
say:5:1621516003:1.source_cn: 真是热闹，像极了莱希拉姆的茶会——不过茶呢？糕点呢？

say:6:1621516004:1.text: Let's see what we have here... Ah. A bunch of losers, debating whether to betray me.
say:6:1621516004:1.source_cn: 啊，只有一群不请自来的宾客，在讨论该不该背叛我。

say:8:1621516005:1.text: This isn't betrayal, it's defiance! We won't allow you to take control of the Serene Lyceum!
say:8:1621516005:1.source_cn: 不是背叛，是反抗！你想掌控莱希拉姆，我们不会让你得逞！

say:9:1621516006:1.text: "We"? You call this a squad? These animals can't even sing in unison!
say:9:1621516006:1.source_cn: “我们”？你身边这几位连合唱都唱不齐的小动物，便是你所...

say:10:1621516007:1.source_cn: 你还是那么天真，汪达尔。

say:11:1621516008:1.text: I won't stand by while you exploit your followers and destroy the bond between us and humans!
say:11:1621516008:1.source_cn: 我不会看着你利用动物的信任，破坏我们和人类之间的纽带！

say:12:1621516009:1.text: Bond? Ha… you really are that loyal to humans. How touching.
say:12:1621516009:1.source_cn: 纽带？哈……真是忠诚得令我感动。

say:13:1621516010:1.text: After wagging your tail at them all this time, I doubt you could survive without them.
say:13:1621516010:1.source_cn: 你在人类面前摇了那么久的尾巴，恐怕离了人类，连口饭都吃...

say:14:1621516011:1.text: Look at how dull your fangs and claws have become! You're a disgrace to all animals!
say:14:1621516011:1.source_cn: 看看你那退化的獠牙与爪子，真是动物界的耻辱！

say:15:1621516012:1.text: Indeed, our fangs and claws are no longer sharp, but we've gained love and trust.
say:15:1621516012:1.source_cn: 是啊，我们退化的是獠牙与爪子，而得到的是爱与信任。

say:16:1621516013:1.text: How pathetic. Trust should be earned through power, not by fawning.
say:16:1621516013:1.source_cn: 真是笑话，信任要靠实力维护，不是靠摇尾巴。

say:17:1621516014:1.text: Now, tell me—are you here just to shout empty slogans, or do you dare to truly challenge me?
say:17:1621516014:1.source_cn: 不过话说回来，你们凑到一起，是为了喊口号，还是……挑战我？

say:18:1621516015:1.text: I'm ready to challenge you, Meowris!
say:18:1621516015:1.source_cn: 我们站在一起，就是为了让你停下！喵丽丝，本汪在此，正式...

say:19:1621516016:1.text: Meowhaha... Challenge accepted! You'll soon regret making an enemy of me!
say:19:1621516016:1.source_cn: 喵哈哈……接受你的挑战，我要让你明白以我为敌是多么蠢！

say:20:1621516017:1.text: But... there's someone special at your side, one who could be loyal to me.
say:20:1621516017:1.source_cn: 不过……你身边倒是个特别的家伙，值得对我献上忠诚。

say:21:1621516018:1.text: You mean my wolf buddy?! Don't even think about it! He's already one of us!
say:21:1621516018:1.male: You mean my wolf buddy?! Don't even think about it! He's already one of us!
say:21:1621516018:1.female: You mean my wolf buddy?! Don't even think about it! She's already one of us!

say:22:1621516019:1.text: Interesting. Why would he need your permission to choose who he supports?
say:22:1621516019:1.male: Interesting. Why would he need your permission to choose who he supports?
say:22:1621516019:1.female: Interesting. Why would she need your permission to choose who she supports?

say:23:1621516020:1.text: Have you two... known each other all this time? My friend, you...
say:23:1621516020:1.source_cn: 你们……早就认识了吗？狼阁下，你……
say:23:1621516020:1.male: Have you two... known each other all this time? My friend, you...
say:23:1621516020:1.female: Have you two... known each other all this time? My friend, you...

choice_prompt:24:1621516020.text: Have you two... known each other all this time? My friend, you...
choice_prompt:24:1621516020.source_cn: 你们……早就认识了吗？狼阁下，你……
choice_prompt:24:1621516020.male: Have you two... known each other all this time? My friend, you...
choice_prompt:24:1621516020.female: Have you two... known each other all this time? My friend, you...

say:25:1621516022:1.text: You still have time to decide who to support before the showdown. Just act according to your lights.
say:25:1621516022:1.source_cn: 我尊重每一个有判断力的动物。你不必现在回答我，在我与汪...
say:25:1621516022:1.male: You still have time to decide who to support before the showdown. Just act according to your lights.
say:25:1621516022:1.female: You still have time to decide who to support before the showdown. Just act according to your lights.

say:26:1621516023:1.text: Hope to hear from you soon.
say:26:1621516023:1.male: Hope to hear from you soon.
say:26:1621516023:1.female: Hope to hear from you soon.

say:27:1621516024:1.text: When Meowris turns to leave, all animals let out a sigh of relief.
say:27:1621516024:1.source_cn: 喵丽丝转身离开了，所有动物都松了一口气。

choice:24:2:3.text: Don't worry, I'm with you now.
choice:24:2:3.source_cn: 别怕，我现在是你的朋友
choice:24:2:3.male: Don't worry, I'm with you now.
choice:24:2:3.female: Don't worry, I'm with you now.
